Aisha Mahmood: Hey folks, first week here! Quick question: HR gave me a note about biometric unlock being enabled on company Macs. Is Face ID/Touch ID mandatory? Also saw a phishing sim notice timed for next week 5/85. If I use a fingerprint, is that stored off-device or synced anywhere? Who's the right contact for privacy concerns?

Priya Kapoor: Welcome Aisha! :tada: Face/Touch ID is optional but recommended for convenience if your machine supports it. We don't sync biometric templates off the device; they're stored in the Secure Enclave on Apple hardware (per policy). If you want a written copy of the privacy FAQ, ping me and I'll send it. Phishing sim: cohort runs Thursday, 2025-05-08, with immediate feedback if you click a test link.

IT Support: Aisha, quick checklist: (1) Confirm macOS is up-to-date, (2) FileVault enabled, (3) Jamf MDM enrolled. To check FileVault: `sudo fdesetup status`. Biometric templates are not exportable from T2/secure enclave devices. If your device is an older model we can force a password-only policy.

Aisha Mahmood: Thanks. My machine shows "Secure Boot: Enabled" in System Report. fdesetup says "FileVault is On". I prefer not to enable Touch ID for now 5, can I opt out without manager approval?

Tom Reyes: You can opt out locally, no manager approval needed. If you opt out we require a stronger password and auto-lock shorter timeout (15m). We may flag it in asset record but that's just for security hygiene.

Aisha Mahmood: Good to know. Also, contractors were in my onboarding list ; I'm on a contractor-turned-fulltime ramp. Are contractors included in the same phishing cohort and training timeline?

Priya Kapoor: Contractors who become full-time are enrolled into the new-hire training on day 1 of conversion. Before conversion, contractors get a reduced training bundle and periodic phishing sims but not the same onboarding schedule. If you were converted, you should see "New Hire Security Basics" in Learning within 24h.

training-bot: Security training assigned: "New Hire Security Basics" -> Aisha Mahmood. Due date: 2025-05-15. Link: https://training.redwood-internal/learn/nh-security-basics

Aisha Mahmood: I got the training email. One last thing: is there an exemption flow if I can't use company-managed biometrics due to accessibility reasons?

Priya Kapoor: Yes 5 please file an accommodation request via HR (privacy-preserving) and cc security@redwood.com. We have an accessibility exemption that replaces biometric requirement with alternative controls (YubiKey or passcode policy).

Tom Reyes: If you want, I can update your asset record to require YubiKey enrollment instead of Touch ID. LMK and I'll create a ticket.

Aisha Mahmood: Appreciate it, Tom. I'll file the accommodation and request YubiKey. Thanks everyone for the quick answers :smile:
